title: [BUG] Closed session transcripts are bulk-rewritten with a shared mtime, destroying file-date signal (114 files at one identical second)
outputText: 114 files share mtime epoch 1787422837 (2026-08-22T21:20:37 local) out of 1,206 session .jsonl; last-prompt and mode carry no timestamp field; median mtime-minus-last-event 17 days; closed transcripts were appended to in one bulk operation; ls -lt reports a burst on a day when no work happened; retention keyed on mtime preserves stale sessions; silent-wrong-output; nothing errors
